_key.description: Coding variant key, phenotype ontology term and source file accession, joined by underscores.

biological_context.example: HEK293 cell line, female, Homo sapiens

avg_gfp.description: Single cell mean GFP fluorescence value per well

avg_mcherry.description: Single cell mean mCherry fluorescence value per well

avg_GFP_mCherry_ratio.description: Ratio of avg_gfp to avg_mcherry for the well, the abundance readout for the variant allele.

wt_GFP_mCherry_ratio.description: GFP-to-mCherry fluorescence ratio of the matched wild-type (WT) reference. WT reference selection, replicate aggregation and quality-control criteria are dataset-specific.

allele_wt_ratio.description: Variant-to-WT fluorescence ratio, calculated as avg_GFP_mCherry_ratio / wt_GFP_mCherry_ratio. Values below 1 indicate lower protein abundance than the matched WT reference; values above 1 indicate higher abundance.

dualipa_abun_score.description: Z-score of the log2 variant-to-WT fluorescence ratio, calculated as (log2(allele_wt_ratio) - mu_wt) / sigma_wt. mu_wt and sigma_wt are the mean and standard deviation of log2-transformed WT:WT reference ratios; their values and calibration scope are dataset-specific. Lower scores indicate lower protein abundance; higher scores indicate higher abundance. A variant-to-WT ratio of 1 corresponds to -mu_wt / sigma_wt, not necessarily zero, so score sign alone does not determine direction relative to WT.

enum_descriptions.Y: Meets the calibrated criteria for an abundance change in either direction. Use allele_wt_ratio or compare dualipa_abun_score with its WT-equivalent value to determine direction.
enum_descriptions.N: Falls within the calibrated no-change range.
enum_descriptions.Uncertain: Falls between the calibrated change and no-change ranges.

dualipa_abun_change.description: Abundance-change classification based on dataset-specific log-likelihood-ratio-calibrated score thresholds.
